rows.author: K126;I081;I078;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SAFE REOPENING OF SCHOOLS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Defines “safe reopening and safe operations of schools” as schools and learning establishments that are logistically prepared 1) to prevent the spread of COVID-19 among teachers, non-teaching personnel, and students and 2) to continue providing education at the same time, with the maximum protection for all individuals . . .
Proposes specific programs to ensure the safe reopening of schools such as proper ventilation of learning spaces; on-campus health facilities and supplies; hiring of human resources for health; testing program for learners; medical fund for free treatment; hazard pay for teachers and education personnel.
 Provides for safe operations to include contact tracing of those who tested positive for COVID-19, its transmission, and prevention.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2022-09-21

rows.author: H057;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR WOMEN EMPOWERMENT AND OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the issue of prevailing inequality between men and women in availing opportunities in public governance; increase the share of women´s role in decision-making, and address the discrimination experiences by women in the field of public service.
Proposes the reservation for qualified women, based on a specific  percentage and classification - appointive positions in the national and local, and provides penalty for non-compliance.
Proposes provisions regarding women in duly-accredited political parties; women in the AFP; an all-female unit in all police stations to attend to victims of rape, battering, incest, and other crimes against women and chastity; inclusion in a human resource development program, gender and development orientation, training, seminars among others; and scholarships, grants, fellowships, and training in the national or local government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WOMEN AND GENDER EQUALITY since 2022-09-21

AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 38 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES," AS AMENDED AND SECTION 6 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "MIGRANT WORKERS AND OVERSEAS FILIPINOS ACT OF 1995," AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Aims to protect Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) from injustice committed against them by an illegal recruiter who forced them to carry out any illegal transaction, enterprise, or scheme.
Seeks to amend the definition of syndicate by lowering the number of perpetrators from three to TWO PERSONS to qualify the act as illegal recruitment by a syndicate.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7925, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "PUBLIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS POLICY ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES", BY REQUIRING PUBLIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS ENTITIES AND INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDERS TO INSTITUTE A REFUND MECHANISM FOR SERVICE OUTAGES AND DISRUPTIONS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the poor quality of internet and cellular connectivity services riddled with service outages, disruptions, and interruptions. 

Proposes to provide a refund credit or a bill adjustment, on a pro-rated basis, to a customer who has experienced a service outage or disruption for an aggregate period of twenty-four (24) hours or more within a month. 

Provides that customers subscribing to a service on a pre-paid basis shall be granted a refund credit or bill adjustment but need not take any action to receive said refund.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09021

rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING ARTICLE 247 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract:
Intends to help prevent a parent from killing or inflicting any serious physical injury to his daughter under 18 years old and her seducer, who were caught in the act of sexual intercourse or immediately after.
Intends also to avoid the legal spouse from murdering his spouse or lover, or both of them, who were caught in the act of sexual intercourse or immediately after. 
Proposes to repeal this discriminatory and unjust law which penalizes the offenders with a mere destierro, and aims to encourage parents and spouses to resolve intra-family problems in a non-violent manner.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING AN INSTALLMENT PAYMENT SCHEME ON BASIC UTILITY BILLS DURING CALAMITIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to cover all residential electric, water, communication, and connectivity bills and shall apply when a state of calamity is declared.
Proposes for the following:  a mandatory moratorium on all residential utility bills for the first three (3) months of a state of calamity; the moratorium may be extended after the first three (3) months of a state of calamity, subject to the determination of the President or the local sanggunian; and installment payment for the deferred liability, without interest, accruing a month after the cessation of a state of calamity.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DISASTER RESILIENCE since 2022-09-21
